# Module `notification`

System notifications (WHATWG Notifications API; src/page/notification.odin, the shell's notification_shell.odin;
native/js/odin/web_notification.odin). A page shows one only when the user granted its origin the permission; the
browser shows it with the system's notifications (gui_toolkit's platform.notify).

Exposed to: Window. Source: `api/notification.widl`.

Odin: `import "wren:notification"`.

## Functions

### `Notification_permission`

```
string Notification_permission()
```

Notification.permission for the realm's origin: "default", "granted" or "denied".

Odin: `notification.permission`.

Host: `Notification_permission :: proc(c: ^Call) -> string`

### `Notification_ask`

```
Promise Notification_ask()
```

Notification.requestPermission(): a promise of the state after (0 default, 1 granted, 2 denied). The user is asked
only after a click or a key press of theirs on the page; otherwise the state stays what it is.

Odin: `notification.ask`.

Host: `Notification_ask :: proc(c: ^Call) -> u64`

### `Notification_show`

```
u64 Notification_show(string title, string body, string tag, bool silent)
```

new Notification(title, {body, tag, silent}): the notification's id, 0 when it is not shown (no permission, no
notification service on this system): the page's object then fires "error". A notification of the same tag
replaces the one before it.

Odin: `notification.show`.

Host: `Notification_show :: proc(c: ^Call, title: string, body: string, tag: string, silent: bool) -> u64`

### `Notification_next`

```
Promise Notification_next(u64 id)
```

What happens next to a shown notification: a promise of 2 (it is shown: the first answer), 0 (a click on it: the
browser brings its tab up) or 1 (it is gone; nothing comes after).

Odin: `notification.next`.

Host: `Notification_next :: proc(c: ^Call, id: u64) -> u64`

### `Notification_close`

```
void Notification_close(u64 id)
```

close(): the system takes it away.

Odin: `notification.close`.

Host: `Notification_close :: proc(c: ^Call, id: u64)`
